parameters.name: Names the person and supplies the fallback initials where supported.
parameters.initials: Sets the letters shown when a photo is unavailable.
parameters.image: Supplies the photo when one is available. The component uses its fallback otherwise.
parameters.shape: Chooses the outline of the component.
parameters.presence: Adds a presence indicator to the avatar.
parameters.selected: The brand ring of a person who is active (speaking, sharing).
parameters.onPressed: Handles activation when the component is interactive.
parameters.label: Supplies the accessible name for the avatar or its action.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
parameters.style: Overrides the component’s themed appearance for this instance.
